sharing_rule: Exact original bytes/dimensions and rendered presentation. Each external portrait path is independently hash-checked; only unused fallback ornaments and byte-identical file/binding names may differ. Project atlas references remain strict.
authoring_instructions: Batch17 isolated source candidate. Exact generation requests, all rejected variants and SHA checks preserved. All source bodies accounted; no raw PNG changes, exclusions, mirrored or duplicate frames. Newly authored reference-based source, not recovered SPX. Native QA staging does NOT grant approval.

visual_review.notes: Provisional stage inputs: reference model, explicitly authored eight directions and all five nominal motion roles, strict full-source geometry/uniqueness/clipping pass. Actual gait exchange, contact timing and cross-role anatomy remain separate SOURCE_HOLD visual gates. Positive stage flags never substitute for completion approval.

packing: Original generated sheet bytes, alpha-bounded AtlasTexture regions and canvas margins
